status: review prototype and handoff, not installed in production
reference: Ice Cream.mp4, approved Hello Static portrait and current mosaic story art

pixel_surface.decorations: Paper, tape, shadows, image and page dots share the same raster. No arbitrary CSS rotation after rasterisation.
pixel_surface.text: Keep native Cubic 11 and semantic controls. Do not rasterize editable text, HUD values, focus or the entire game UI.

camera_impacts.unit: CSS pixels of scene displacement, independent of screen width; proposed tuning, not production-tested
camera_impacts.coalescing: One camera event per cast/main impact; repeated DoT, secondary targets, shards and echo ticks do not refresh it. No amplitude summing.
camera_impacts.preferences: shake=false, reduced motion/effects, offline and hidden page suppress motion; do not move HUD or operation panel

hero_motion.owner: characters-render.js and actual movement/dodge events; existing clip/rig assets retained
hero_motion.speed_source: Actual grounded displacement per simulated second, not desired velocity into obstacles
hero_motion.roll_trigger: A real existing combat dodge event or warning-avoidance dash if its simulation explicitly emits that event; no cosmetic rolls with invented invulnerability
hero_motion.roll_readability: Preserve one event token across the complete anticipation/tuck/turn/landing/recovery; no early reset when h.dash is removed at 300ms
hero_motion.legs: Keep running legs for moving attacks where upper-body blend exists; otherwise use a bounded attack/cast windup window before returning to run
prohibitions: no forced rolls for all ranged attacks
